pll2d7c1-d1e3514.summary: Recalls that the angels who stood were confirmed by grace and those who fell were deserted by it. The good are so confirmed that they cannot sin, the bad so obstinate that they cannot have a good will, though they sometimes will what God wills, which is good, but not with a good will.
claims: Good angels cannot sin; bad angels cannot will well.

pl-l2d7c1.summary: States that the good angels are so confirmed by grace that they cannot sin, and the bad so obstinate in malice that they cannot have a good will; even when they will what God wills, which is good, they do not will it with a good will.
claims: The good angels are confirmed by grace so that they cannot sin.
The bad angels are so obstinate that they cannot will well.
The bad angels may will something good, but not with a good will.
